scalars.revision: integer >= 0; identity ordinal bound to actual current snapshot hash
scalars.name: 0=Deebo, 1=Tibo, 2=Mira
scalars.override: boolean: either override field is non-null
scalars.serverOwner: -1 or client id; preserves synchronous tx-to-notify ordering
scalars.backgroundDone: boolean: one failed/null linked translation completed

adapter.initial: All clients closed; linked translation failed/null; no edit receipts. Override fixture has non-null override fields. Actual hashes/UUIDs stay in observe(), not symbolic projection.
adapter.send: Explicit user action; freeze POST body and codec token; actual transport counter increments exactly once.
adapter.transaction: Capture actual pre-transaction snapshot and post-transaction checkpoint; mismatch always conflicts, even for rollback fault. Commit with unchanged name and absent override creates receipt, preserves revision, skips notification.
adapter.notification: Actual synchronous production checkpoint observed from test-only child preload. Failure is best effort and cannot relabel a committed save as unchanged.
adapter.response: Never deliver a late callback after an aborted fetch; hold a successful HTTP response before delivering it instead.
adapter.recovery: lookup is GET only; unavailable lookup leaves draft and uncertainty; close/reopen reads actual persisted value.
adapter.background: setTranslation on initial linked segment, once; no name or receipt changes.
adapter.mutation: Model-only automatic_resend increments requests without userSaves. A real negative must independently mutate/check actual request or transaction behavior.

scope.lateResponses: Delay delivery across another completed client operation; no post-abort callback fiction.
scope.liveness: Safety and finite reachable witnesses only. Eventual completion would additionally require fair transaction/response scheduling and successful recovery reads.
